QC Description: The dcMetadata table must contain one and only one record for each of the country’s river basin districts, identified by the euRBDCode. Identifier missing : Identifier duplicated:
Message: The dcMetadata table must contain one and only one record for each of the country’s river basin districts, identified by the euRBDCode. Identifier missing Values: {%identifiers%} . Number of invalid values: {%numberofrecords%} [T002_WFD]
Expression:
SELECT X.record_id
	,CASE 
		WHEN LENGTH(X.ids) > 4000
			THEN CONCAT (
					LEFT(X.ids, CASE 
							WHEN POSITION(',' IN REVERSE(LEFT(X.ids, 3997))) > 0
								THEN 3997 - POSITION(',' IN REVERSE(LEFT(X.ids, 3997)))
							ELSE 3997
							END)
					,'...'
					)
		ELSE X.ids
		END AS identifiers
	,X.numberofrecords
FROM (
	SELECT (
			SELECT record_id
			FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata" limit 1
			) AS record_id
		,listagg(rf.thematicididentifier , ', ') AS ids
		,COUNT(*) AS numberofrecords
	FROM dataset_37016."riverbasindistrictwfd" rf
	WHERE rf.thematicididentifier NOT IN (
			SELECT sub.euRBDCode
			FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata" sub
			)
		AND rf."statuscode" IN (
			'valid'
			,'stable'
			) 
		AND rf.countrycode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
	HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
	) X

Message: The Monitoring table must always list the groundwater monitoring sites for quantitative monitoring ('EEA_00-01-1') for every river basin district with designated groundwater bodies. [T404_WFD]  Values: {%identifiers%}. Number of missing values: {%numberofrecords%}   [T404_WFD]
Expression:
WITH
    -- Retrieve all RBDs for which monitoring data has been submitted.
    rbd_metadata AS (
        SELECT
            euRBDCode,
            record_id
        FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata"
        WHERE "includesMonitoringData" = 'yes'
    ),

    spatial_flag AS (
        SELECT
            MAX(CASE WHEN "includesspatialdata" = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_spatial
        FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata"
    ),

    -- Identify RBDs that contain at least one eligible GWB (valid or stable).
    rbd_with_eligible_gwb AS (
        SELECT
            r.thematicIdIdentifier AS euRBDCode
        FROM dataset_37016."riverbasindistrictwfd" r
        WHERE r.statusCode IN ('valid', 'stable')
          AND r.countrycode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
          AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" rz
                WHERE rz.relatedZoneIdentifier       = r.thematicIdIdentifier
                  AND rz.thematicIdIdentifierScheme  = 'euGroundWaterBodyCode'
                  AND rz.statusCode                 IN ('valid', 'stable')
